notes.title: Patch 17: improving terrain visuals when planting seeds
notes.notes: Hi! Previously, the ground and grass were not changing around a planted seed. As a result, the seeds were sometimes hidden in the grass, which made players rather confused. Now, the area around the planted seeds has a darker ground, and the grass is removed. This modification is reset at the beginning of each chapter, to simulate grass natural growth :) (and avoid a terrain filled with holes ;) )

notes.title: Patch 16: adjustable walking speed!
notes.notes: Hi! Several testers said they were very annoyed by the walking speed. So I added a new settings menu where you can adjust Agnès' walking speed. It's on the top right corner menu (cogwheel) => "Settings".

notes.title: Patch 15: multiple fixes and small UI added!
notes.notes:
Hi! I have added several small fixes that should make the game more clear :)
- New pop up when hovering the calendar to know what is missing for the next turn
- Particles to highlight the collections
- Fix a saving issue
- Repared the responsiveness of the UI
- Fixed some typos in the dialogs
- Renamed some objectives for clarity

notes.title: Patch 14: fixing movement bug
notes.notes: Playtesters reported a bug with the character leaning backwards! It's now fixed :)

notes.title: Patch 13: Fixing saving bug
notes.notes: We had an issue reported by a few players that was appearing when loading several files one after another. It's now fixed :)

notes.title: Patch 12: Better character movement!
notes.notes:
We were not happy with some parts of the character movement for a while, and had reports of issues in the closed beta so we reworked on the movement, it should be much better :)

Here are the changes:
- proper orientation and position of the character when moving with an action on click,
- preventing movement during an animation,
- no more climbing on bushes and walls ;)

notes.title: Patch 11: Closed beta!!! Chapter1 and a lot of improvements!
notes.notes:
Hi playtesters! This patch is another big one :) It holds the content of the closed beta!

While the alpha was only available through a key sent by email, now there will be a button to apply on the Steam page (later today). So it's more public, but not as public as a demo ;)

It's also less polished than the demo: it's still testing ^^ (we still have a huge todo list before the demo is ready ;) )

There is more content too! Now there are 3 turns available to play in the game, right from the start, in March 1643 :) There are new plants and characters to discover too! 

We hope you'll like it! :)

notes.title: Patch 10: Chapter 3 and plant growth
notes.notes: This patch is a big one, as we are getting ready for the closed alpha! Now there are 2 turns available to play in the game, and the plant grow according to their happiness and the months when you change the turn :) There are also new character :) We hope you'll like it!

notes.title: Patch 09: fixing save
notes.notes: Some playtesters noticed saving/loading issues. We were able to reproduce and fix them, seems all good (but please test it if you can ;) )

notes.title: Patch 08: SFX!
notes.notes:
This new version finally includes SFX in the game :) It is a work-in-progress, but I am very interested in your feedback on it!

Besides that, the change of turn feature has been integrated, but you cannot see it yet in the game: that's the next change coming :)

notes.title: Patch 07: Saving and examine panel
notes.notes:
A new alpha test version is available with saving and loading (top-right menu). 
There is also a new version of the Examine panel (close-up on a plant and its data). I hope you'll like it!

notes.title: Patch 06: Better visuals and fixing colliders preventing from clicking on plants
notes.notes:
Hi! After the last visual improvements, some colliders' issues were preventing players from clicking on some plants and collection items. They are now fixed! 

I also included a lot of visual improvements made during the month in this patch! I hope you'll like them!

notes.title: Patch 05: better movement and visuals
notes.notes: I improved the movement system, which was not fluid and reworked the visuals for Turn 2 so it looks less like a sunset and more like an afternoon in April.

notes.title: Patch 04: Better terrain and shadows
notes.notes: I changed how the terrain is done and added a lot of grass and texture on roads (hopefully without any drop in framerate ;) ). I also improved the lighting. Now there are shadows in the game. I hope you'll like it!

notes.title: Patch 03: Moving with keyboard!
notes.notes: Hi! Several alpha testers reported the movement of the character with the mouse was the biggest issue with the game's UX. Now it's fixed! You can move with either WASD (ZQSD if you have a French keyboard) or the arrows!

notes.title: Patch 02: Plants in book and small fixes
notes.notes:
We added plant illustrations according to their growth stage. They will appear in the book once examining the plant in the garden. 

Some quality of life and polish: full background for the map, collection action on the magnifying glass.

notes.title: Patch 01: welcome message
notes.notes: Adding a welcome message to introduce the alpha test.
